Normalization must apply the effective vocabulary (project overlay included) as known-id membership check, not the packaged index alone
Criteria dimension labels are open by design; normalization must pass through unknown labels unchanged to preserve open dimensions and project criteria
Calibration document embeds closed-vocabulary mistake in five load-bearing locations and incorrectly characterizes `sec` and `project.review-phase-boundaries` as non-tunable
After normalization, `documentation` findings with impact > 0 must still surface while those with impact 0 are dropped by nit-suppression
